column1: # Reference repositories (guide §3). scripts/refs.sh clones each one into refs/ at its pinned SHA.
# Pins were verified on 2026-10-11. No repository has a release tag at or after its pin (version-baseline.md),
# so every pin stays. Columns are tab-separated; "-" means empty. Changing a pin changes the guide, this file,
# version-baseline.md and, if a path moves, docs/reference/REFERENCE-INDEX.md (pnpm refs:index).
